selection: Lowest training-only date-balanced OOF raw Brier across all ten feature/family configurations; deterministic feature/family tie break. External results cannot change selection.
control: Best training-only OHLCV-19 family refit on exactly the same rows/dates. Context arm separately selects its family inside training.
market_definition: Completed same-day observed-universe equal-weight return, breadth, volume, dispersion and stock-relative momentum. NOT a tradable index or KOSPI/KOSDAQ.
cohort: One shared cohort finite in all 29 causal features; report excluded rows and never change production universe.
target: Five observed sessions close return > 0.003; unchanged absolute target
regressor: Each arm uses its own features with the unchanged absolute-error regressor and calibration residual bounds. Return outputs are conditional-median proxies, not expected means.
evaluation_role: Already inspected historical development dates, NOT new independent validation. October tail is short diagnostic only.
